info.name: Voice Agent - D4 call runtime
info.description:
D4: inbound authorisation, Retell webhooks, metering, calls API, stats aur SSE (spec §13.9, §13.10, §14, §16; ADR 0011).

## Ek line me kahani

Koi customer ke number par call karta hai → Retell humse poochta hai "uthaun?" (folder B) → call chalti hai aur khatam hoti hai, Retell events bhejta hai (folder C) → credits kat te hain → customer dashboard me call dekhta hai (folder D, E).

## Setup

```sh
pnpm infra:up && pnpm db:deploy && pnpm db:seed
pnpm --filter @portal/api dev        # API :4000 par
pnpm --filter @portal/api dev:worker # ALAG terminal me — ye zaroori hai!
pnpm --filter @portal/api load:setup # number_token, to_number, workspace_id print karega
```

**Worker chalana mat bhoolna.** D4 me API sirf webhook store karke queue me daal deta hai; asli kaam (calls row banana, credits kaatna, SSE bhejna) worker karta hai. Worker band hoga to sab 200 aayega par database me kuch nahi badlega.

## Environment variables

| Variable | Kahan se |
| --- | --- |
| `retell_api_key` | `.env` ka `RETELL_API_KEY` — **signature isi se banta hai** |
| `number_token`, `to_number`, `workspace_id` | `load:setup` ka output |
| `token` | Customer JWT (D3 collection me OAuth helper ki setting hai) |
| `from_number` | Kuch bhi, default `+19377293562` |

## Signature kaise banta hai

Retell ka koi alag webhook secret nahi hai — API key hi signing key hai. `x-retell-signature: v=<ms>,d=<HMAC-SHA256(apiKey, rawBody + ms)>`, ±5 minute ki window.

Har signed request ka pre-request script body ko `{{signed_body}}` me daal deta hai aur usi exact string ko sign karta hai. **Request ki raw body me `{{signed_body}}` ke alawa kuch mat likhna** — ek extra space bhi signature tod dega, kyunki verify raw bytes par hota hai.

## Isme kya nahi hai

Concurrency race aur latency SLO Postman se test nahi ho sakte. Unke liye:
`backend/api/test/calls.e2e.test.ts` (20 ek saath aane wali calls vs cap 3) aur `pnpm --filter @portal/api load:inbound` (k6, `p(95)<300` threshold ke saath).

item.name: A. Shuru karne se pehle
item.description:
Pehle `pnpm infra:up && pnpm db:deploy && pnpm db:seed`, phir API `:4000` par chalao.

Environment me ye bharna zaroori hai:

| Variable | Kahan se milega |
| --- | --- |
| `retell_api_key` | `.env` ka `RETELL_API_KEY`. Signature isi se banta hai, isliye API ki key se **bilkul same** hona chahiye. |
| `number_token`, `to_number`, `workspace_id` | `pnpm --filter @portal/api load:setup` chalao — ye teeno print kar deta hai, ek ready-made workspace ke saath (live agent, active number, 100k credits, cap 500). |
| `token` | Customer JWT. D3 collection me OAuth 2.0 helper ki poori setting likhi hai; wahi yahan bhi chalega. |

Folder order maayne rakhta hai: **B** call ko authorise karta hai, **C** usi call ko bill karta hai, **D/E** us call ko padhte hain. Collection Runner me upar se neeche chalao.

item.name: 2. Environment check — sab variables bhare hain?

request.description:
Ye request kuch naya nahi maangti — bas environment check karti hai, taki aage ki galtiyaan samajhne me waqt na jaaye.

**Sabse common galti:** `number_token` khali reh jaata hai. Tab URL `/webhooks/retell/inbound/` ban jaata hai (token ke bina), route use token-mismatch samajhta hai aur fail-open `200 {}` de deta hai. Status 200 dikhega, par `call_inbound` undefined hoga aur tests `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'agent_override')` se fail honge. Ye bug nahi hai — yahi design hai (ADR 0011 §2), bas input adhoora tha.

Values yahan se lo:

```sh
pnpm --filter @portal/api load:setup
```

Wo `NUMBER_TOKEN`, `TO_NUMBER`, `WORKSPACE_ID` print karta hai. `retell_api_key` `.env` ke `RETELL_API_KEY` se **exactly** same hona chahiye — wahi webhook signing key bhi hai.

**Dhyan rakho:** har `load:setup` naya number banata hai, aur `load:teardown` purane numbers pause kar deta hai. Purana token dobara use karoge to `paused` decline milega.

request.description:
Folder **D, E, F** ko customer JWT chahiye. Bina uske `401 UNAUTHENTICATED — "Sign in to continue."` milega, jo bilkul sahi hai: har customer route authenticated hai by default, `@Public()` sirf webhooks aur recording stream par lagta hai.

### Step 1 — token lo

Kisi bhi ek D/E request ke **Authorization** tab me jaao, type **OAuth 2.0** rakho aur ye bharo (customer tenant, SPA app `Voice Agent`):

| Setting | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Grant type | Authorization Code (With PKCE) |
| Auth URL | `https://dev-tpj0dmu6yauk2360.us.auth0.com/authorize` |
| Access Token URL | `https://dev-tpj0dmu6yauk2360.us.auth0.com/oauth/token` |
| Client ID | `l0UZ5TKdAcHETAzg0swJFIVeFftfJBd3` |
| Client Secret | *khali chhodo* — SPA hai, browser me secret nahi hota (ADR 0008) |
| Callback URL | `https://oauth.pstmn.io/v1/callback` |
| Scope | `openid profile email` |
| Advanced → Auth request params | `audience` = `https://api.metacognixion.com` |
| **Client Authentication** | **Send client credentials in body** |

**Client Authentication zaroor badalna.** Postman default me *Send as Basic Auth header* rakhta hai, yaani khali secret ke saath `Authorization: Basic base64(client_id:)`. Ye app SPA (public client) hai — uska koi secret hai hi nahi — to Auth0 us header ko confidential-client ki koshish samajh ke `access_denied: Unauthorized` de deta hai. Body me bhejne par wo PKCE flow maanta hai aur `code_verifier` se verify karta hai.

### Do gotchas jo waqt kha jaate hain

- **Trailing newline.** In values ko kahin se copy-paste karoge to line break saath aa sakta hai. URL me wo `%0A` ban jaata hai: `.../oauth/token%0A` → **404**, aur error message asli wajah nahi batata. Paste ke baad `End` daba ke dekh lo ki cursor usi line par hai.
- **`audience` chhodna mat.** Uske bina Auth0 opaque token deta hai, JWT nahi, aur API use verify nahi kar payegi.

Kahan atke ho, ye console batata hai: `/authorize` par **302** matlab client id aur callback URL dono theek hain; uske baad `/oauth/token` ka jawab batata hai client authentication sahi hai ya nahi.

**Get New Access Token** dabao, browser me login karo, phir token dialog me **Access Token copy karo**.

> Callback URL Auth0 app ki *Allowed Callback URLs* me hona chahiye, warna Auth0 callback reject kar dega.

### Step 2 — token ko local account se jodo

Sirf valid token kaafi nahi hai. API caller ko `users.auth_provider_id = <jwt ka sub>` se dhoondta hai, aur jiske peeche row nahi wo token bhi 401 deta hai. Wo row normally Auth0 ki Post-User-Registration Action banati hai (`POST /webhooks/auth`) — wo D5 par aayega. Tab tak haath se:

```sh
cd backend/api
pnpm exec dotenv -e ../../.env -- tsx scripts/dev-link-user.ts "<token>" <workspace_id>
```

`workspace_id` **de dena** — wahi jo `load:setup` ne diya tha. Us workspace me folder B/C se banayi hui asli calls hain, to `GET /calls` khali nahi aayega. Bina workspace_id ke script ek naya khali workspace banata hai aur 20 trial credits deta hai.

### Step 3 — Postman me daalo

1. Copy kiya hua token environment ke **`token`** variable me paste karo.
2. Jis request par aapne OAuth 2.0 set kiya tha, uske Authorization tab me type wapas **"Inherit auth from parent"** kar do. Collection already `Bearer {{token}}` bhejti hai, to sab requests ek hi jagah se token uthayengi.
3. `workspace_id` wahi rakho jo step 2 me diya tha — `X-Workspace-Id` header usi se banta hai.

### Do header kyun chahiye

`Authorization` batata hai **aap kaun ho**, `X-Workspace-Id` batata hai **kis business ka data**. Ek user kai workspaces ka member ho sakta hai (`memberships`), isliye token se workspace infer nahi kiya ja sakta. `WorkspaceGuard` membership check karta hai, phir Postgres RLS doosri layer hai.

exec: pm.test('token environment me hai', () => pm.expect(t, 'Docs tab padho — 3 step hain').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty);
pm.test('JWT jaisa dikhta hai (3 hisse)', () => pm.expect(parts).to.have.lengthOf(3));
pm.test('token expire nahi hua', () => pm.expect(left, left + ' min baaki').to.be.above(0));
console.log('sub:', claims.sub, '| aud:', claims.aud, '|', left, 'min baaki');
console.log('agar 401 aa raha hai to dev-link-user.ts is sub ke saath chalao');
} catch (e) { console.log('payload decode nahi hua:', e.message); }

item.name: B. Inbound authorisation (§13.9) — latency wala rasta
item.description:
`POST /webhooks/retell/inbound/:number_token` — **poore system ka sabse time-critical endpoint**.

Jab koi customer ke number par call karta hai, Retell pehle humse poochta hai: *ye call uthaun ya nahi?* Hamare paas 10 second ka hard timeout hai aur SLO p95 < 300 ms hai. Isliye ye route **sirf Redis** padhta hai (4 keys, 2 round trip, 150 ms ka budget) — Postgres ko chhuta tak nahi. `calls` row baad me queue se likhi jaati hai.

Chhe check is order me: kill switch → workspace paused → number paused/agent nahi → blocklist → balance vs grace → concurrency cap → business hours.

**Sabse important baat:** yahan koi bhi galti 4xx nahi deti. Retell non-2xx ko decline nahi samajhta — wo 3 baar retry karta hai aur phir apne bound agent se call utha leta hai. To galat signature, unknown number, Redis down — sab `200 {}` (fail open) dete hain. Asli decline sirf `200 {call_inbound:{reject:true}}` hota hai (ADR 0003 §1).

request.description:
Sab kuch theek hai to Retell ko batate hain: kaun sa agent uthaye, kitne der tak bol sakta hai, aur metadata me `tenant_id` — jise baad me `call_ended` billing ke liye use karta hai.

`max_call_duration_ms = min(planMax, remainingCredits/rate × 60000)`, Retell ki [60s, 2h] limit me clamp karke. `remainingCredits` matlab balance **minus jitna baaki live calls abhi kharch kar sakte hain** — isi liye `active:{ws}` ab counter nahi, per-call reservation hash hai (ADR 0011 §1).

Yahan 401 dena **galat** hota. Socho: kisi ne API key rotate kar di aur signature match nahi ho raha — agar hum 401 dete, to caller ko 2 second ring sunai deti aur phir bhi call uth jaati (Retell bound agent se). Matlab 401 se kuch bacha nahi, sirf caller ka time gaya.

item.name: C. Lifecycle webhooks (§14) — paisa yahan chalta hai
item.description:
`POST /webhooks/retell` — teeno lifecycle events isi ek route par aate hain. Har event ka rasta same hai:

1. raw body par signature verify → galat hua to **401, kuch store nahi**
2. `webhook_events` me upsert, unique `(provider, external_id, event_type)`
3. already processed duplicate → **204**, kuch nahi karte
4. BullMQ queue me daalo → **200 `{received:true}`** turant

Asli processing queue me hoti hai, 8 attempts exponential backoff ke saath. Event store hone ke baad provider ko kabhi 5xx nahi milta — kyunki Retell ke liye retry storm ka matlab hai live call par asar, aur Stripe ke liye 3 din ki retries se behtar hamari apni queue hai.

**Paise ka rule:** sirf `call_ended` credits kaatta hai. `call_started` credits *reserve* karta hai aur rate lock karta hai. `call_analyzed` sirf transcript/analysis save karta hai — **kabhi bill nahi karta**.

request.description:
Call uth gayi. Yahan do kaam hote hain:

**Rate capture.** `calls.rate` aur `calls.config_version` **ek hi baar** likhe jaate hain aur kabhi overwrite nahi hote. Wajah: agar call ke beech me admin pricing badal de, to chal rahi call ka rate badalna nahi chahiye — customer ko wahi rate lagega jo call shuru hote waqt tha (ADR 0011 §4).

**Reservation.** `active:{ws}` hash me is call ka slot HSETNX se likhte hain. HSETNX isliye ki agar Retell wahi event dobara bheje, to do reservation na ban jaayein.

item.name: 2. call_ended — yahi ek event bill karta hai

request.description:
`duration_s = (end_timestamp − start_timestamp)/1000`, `credits = duration_s/60 × rate`, 0.01 tak round.

Yahan 120 second bheja hai, standard tier (1 credit/min) par = **2.00 credits**.

Agar `disconnection_reason` batata hai ki call connect hi nahi hui (`dial_busy`, `dial_no_answer`, `dial_failed`) to charge **0** hota hai — customer ko ring ke paise nahi dene chahiye.

Idempotency application code se nahi, **database se** aati hai: `credit_ledger (ref_id) WHERE reason='call'` par partial unique index hai. Replay hone par insert collide karta hai — `if (!exists)` jaisa check race condition me double-bill kar sakta tha, isliye us par bharosa nahi kiya.

item.name: 3. call_ended dobara — replay, double charge nahi

request.description:
Bilkul wahi event dobara. Agar worker pehla event process kar chuka hai to **204** milega — "ye to ho chuka, kuch mat karo".

**Dhyan se:** agar aap turant chala do aur worker abhi busy ho, to **200** milega, 204 nahi. Ye bug nahi hai — `store()` stored-but-unprocessed event ke liye `retry` return karta hai, taki ek event jo queue tak pahunche bina reh gaya ho wo phir se enqueue ho jaaye. Ledger phir bhi double nahi hoga, kyunki asli guard database ka unique index hai. 204 dekhna ho to 2–3 second ruk ke chalao.

Retell call khatam hone ke ~30 second baad analysis bhejta hai: summary, sentiment, custom fields.

Ye event **kabhi credits nahi kaatta**. Agar kaat deta to har call do baar bill hoti. Ye sirf `analysis_json` aur `retell_cost_cents` (hamari apni COGS reporting ke liye, customer ko kabhi nahi dikhta) save karta hai.

Inbound route se ulta — **yahan 401 dena bilkul sahi hai**.

Farak kyun? Inbound par koi live caller line par wait kar raha hota hai, aur reject karne se uska nuksaan hota hai. Yahan koi wait nahi kar raha. item.name: D. Calls API (§16) — D2 screen ka data
item.description:
Ab jab call authorise bhi ho gayi aur bill bhi ho gayi, customer use dashboard me dekhega. Ye saare route normal authenticated route hain: `Authorization: Bearer` + `X-Workspace-Id`, aur Postgres RLS doosri layer hai.

Ek design decision jo poore folder me dikhta hai: database me status `declined` hai, par customer ko **"missed"** dikhta hai. Customer ko ye nahi sochna chahiye ki humne uski call "decline" ki — uske liye wo bas ek missed call hai.

Chhoti si detail: `is_test` ko `z.coerce.boolean()` se parse nahi kiya, kyunki wo string `"false"` ko `true` padh leta hai — query string me sab kuch text hota hai.

request.description:
Recording do step me milti hai, aur iski wajah important hai.

Browser ka `<audio>` tag `Authorization` header nahi bhej sakta. Seedha Retell ka URL de dena aasan tha, par wo URL khud ek bearer credential hai customer ki call audio ke liye — uski expiry hamare control me nahi, aur wo browser history/logs me chala jaata hai.

To hum apna HMAC-signed token banate hain: ek call se bandha, ek workspace se bandha, 1 ghante me mar jaata hai. Retell ka URL browser tak kabhi nahi pahunchta (ADR 0011 §5).

request.description:
Live updates ka stream. Dashboard ise khol ke rakhta hai, aur call aate hi UI update ho jaata hai — polling ki zaroorat nahi.

**Postman me ye request latak jaayegi (hang)** — ye normal hai, stream band hi nahi hota. Cancel kar do. Terminal me behtar dikhta hai:

```sh
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
     -H "X-Workspace-Id: $WS" \
     "http://localhost:4000/events?topics=wallet"
```

Ye chala ke doosre terminal se folder C ka `call_ended` maaro — `call:{id}` par `ended` frame aur `wallet` par ledger frame dono turant dikhenge.

Ek design note: ye normal authenticated route hai, magic nahi. Browser ka built-in `EventSource` `Authorization` aur `X-Workspace-Id` header bhej hi nahi sakta, isliye frontend `@microsoft/fetch-event-source` use karta hai. Aur `?topics=` se narrow kar sakte ho, par workspace kabhi nahi badal sakte — stream hamesha sirf `ctx.workspaceId` ka channel hi padhta hai.

item.name: F. Guards — kya block hona chahiye
item.description: Ye requests **fail honi chahiye**. Agar koi pass ho gaya to security hole hai.

request.description: Har customer route ko workspace chahiye. JWT batata hai *kaun*, header batata hai *kis business ka data*. Ek user kai workspaces me ho sakta hai.
404, 403 nahi — 403 se confirm ho jaata ki wo id exist karti hai. RLS doosri layer hai: `withWorkspace()` ke bahar koi query khali database dekhti hai, kyunki `app.tenant_id` set hi nahi hota.
Route `@Public()` hai, magar token hi credential hai. Bina token ke kuch nahi milta.
